description: Classify pull-request review comments as actionable, noise, closed, stale, or duplicate from caller-supplied comment facts: author kind, thread state, failing-check linkage, and body. Returns one verdict per comment with the exact rule that fired as evidence.

author_kind.description: Whether the author is a bot or a human

duplicate_of.description: Id of another comment this one duplicates (optional)

failing_check.description: Whether the comment is attached to a currently failing check

name: triage_review_comments
